title: Supplier Commodity Manager
teaser: Become part of our team as a Supplier Commodity Manager, driving strategic sourcing and commodity management for key technologies. Lead supplier relationship management and operational excellence, while ensuring compliance and sustainability. Ideal for experienced professionals in PCB sub-tier material laminate management and supply chain operations.
description:
Position Responsibilities:

Strategic Sourcing & Commodity Management: Develop and execute comprehensive commodity strategies for assigned technologies (including PCB sub-tier laminates) through cross-functional collaboration with engineering, operations, and business units.

Supplier Relationship & Performance Management: Build and maintain executive-level relationships, conducting data-driven Supplier Business Reviews (SBRs) to monitor performance across cost, quality, technology, and sustainability.

Operational Excellence: Manage end-to-end supply chain operations, including capacity planning, material delivery, inventory lifecycle management, and return-to-vendor (RTV) processes.

Negotiation & RFQ Leadership: Lead quarterly cost reduction initiatives, manage the RFQ process, validate supplier data, and execute award splits to ensure maximum cost competitiveness.

Contract Negotiation & Legal Compliance: Partner with the legal team to negotiate and finalize Master Purchase Agreements (MPA), Statements of Work (SOW), and other binding legal contracts.

Market Intelligence & Risk Mitigation: Track industry trends and price fluctuations to produce data-driven sensing reports and proactively mitigate geopolitical or supply chain disruption risks.

Supply Chain Resiliency: Lead the qualification and ramp-up of alternate non-China manufacturing sites to ensure supply chain continuity and resiliency.

Sustainability Compliance: Ensure supplier adherence to Cisco and industry sustainability standards (GHG, Responsible Minerals, RBA) and drive the closure of open action items.

Multi-Sourcing & Value Engineering: Identify and execute multi-sourcing opportunities to enhance supply flexibility and cost competitiveness through engineering collaboration.

Financial Liability Management: Document and report open financial liabilities—including Advance Purchases, Risk Buys, and Last-time Buys—to Finance, ensuring strict process compliance.

Lead-time Optimization: Drive lead-time reduction initiatives with suppliers to minimize financial exposure and improve operational performance metrics.

Strategic Projects & Reporting: Lead organizational initiatives, and draft executive-level supplier white papers as required by leadership.

Required Qualifications:

BS or equivalent with 8+ years of relevant experience.

Experience in PCB commodity sub-tier material laminate management, supply chain operations, business, supplier management.

Experience evaluating market trends of PCB and laminate, supplier data, and ability to translate to business outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications:

Extensive business strategy and implementation knowledge

Strong interpersonal communication and relationship management skills

Relevant certifications contract management, or supply chain

Thorough understanding of commodity markets, price fluctuations, and factors influencing market dynamics
